stemMd: Why did the later observations matter to the parking proposal?

options.label: A
options.textMd: They demonstrated that the courtyard was structurally unsafe

options.label: B
options.textMd: They proved that residents owned no cars

options.label: C
options.textMd: They revealed uses that the original comparison had omitted

options.label: D
options.textMd: They established that parking was illegal

options.label: E
options.textMd: They showed that every resident opposed parking

explanationMd: The original argument treated the courtyard as empty. Observations identified several existing functions, changing the opportunity costs of conversion. They improved the comparison without deciding the final priority.

distractorRationale.d: The passage makes no legal claim.
